Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology
Cnidaria.question: The _____ was Aquatic animal phylum having cnidocytes.
Cnidaria.fact: Cnidaria ( nih-DAIR-ee-ə, ny-) is a phylum of animals containing over 11,000 species of aquatic invertebrates found both in freshwater and marine environments (predominantly the latter), including jellyfish, hydroids, sea anemones, corals and some of the smallest marine parasites. Many cnidarian species can reproduce both sexually and asexually.

Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology

Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology

Cnidaria.fact: Staurozoa have recently been recognised as a class in their own right rather than a sub-group of Scyphozoa, and the highly derived parasitic Myxozoa and Polypodiozoa were firmly recognized as cnidarians only in 2007.

Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology

Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology

Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology
Cnidaria.question: Ptychocysts are found only in the order _____, tube anemones

Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology

Cnidaria.fact: ("cnida" is derived from the Greek word κνίδη, which means "nettle") A tube-like extension of the wall of the cnida that points into the cnida, like the finger of a rubber glove pushed inwards.

Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology
Cnidaria.question: At least four hypotheses have been proposed: _____ contraction of fibers round the cnida may increase its internal pressure

Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology

Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology

Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology

Cnidaria.subject: Agricultural Entomology
